🚨 severity: BLOCKING —
🚨 **BLOCKING: CI red — `docs-freshness` fails on head `c4f246da` (stale generated docs)**

The PR adds two new `customParams` keys to the dev leg's config surface (`js/developTicketAndCreatePR.js` → `initDevelopmentContext`), so the agent-doc generator's output changes — but the regenerated docs are not committed. CI failed:

- Run: https://github.com/IstiN/dmtools-agents/actions/runs/42989719055/job/130419330438
- `##[error]docs/agents/generated or snapshots is stale. Run 'node js/agentDocGenerator.js && node generate_agent_snapshots.js' and commit the result.`

Reproduced locally on the PR head — the generator diff is exactly three files, byte-identical to CI's failure diff:

```text
 docs/agents/generated/bug_development.md                | 4 ++++
 docs/agents/generated/story_development.md              | 4 ++++
 docs/agents/generated/story_development_dynamic_repo.md | 4 ++++
```

The entries are correct content, not generator noise: the knob is genuinely read by the bug dev leg too (`js/developBugAndCreatePR.js:870` delegates into `developTicket.action(params)` → `initDevelopmentContext` → `applyDevelopmentMode`), and `story_development_dynamic_repo.json` inherits the same action through its `parent: story_development.json`.

**Fix** (no code change needed — regen + commit):

```bash
node js/agentDocGenerator.js && node generate_agent_snapshots.js
git add docs/agents/generated snapshots
git commit -m "gh-1435: regenerate agent docs for the developmentMode knob"
```

Verification note: the unit suite is green on this head — `dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_developmentMode.json` = 36/36 PASS, and the full `run_all.json` under the CI node harness = 9638 passed / 0 failed. `docs-freshness` is the only red check; fixing it unblocks merge.

comments.author: unknown
comments.body:
💡 severity: SUGGESTION —
💡 **SUGESTION: README documents the knob for one leg — it is live on three**

This section says *"The story development leg (`story_development.json` → `developTicketAndCreatePR.js`) reads an optional `developmentMode` knob"* and the last bullet says *"so other dev legs **can adopt** the knob without duplicating the logic"* — implying other legs have not adopted it yet. In this PR they already have:

- `bug_development` — `js/developBugAndCreatePR.js:870` calls `developTicket.action(params)`, which runs `initDevelopmentContext` → `applyDevelopmentMode`. The knob is read on that leg today.
- `story_development_dynamic_repo` — the regenerated generated docs (the ones CI requires you to commit) list `developmentMode`/`developmentModeConfig` for this agent as well.

A deployer configuring `bug_development` from the README would conclude the knob does nothing for their leg, while `docs/agents/generated/bug_development.md` says it does.

Suggested fix (one sentence, rides the same commit as the doc regeneration):

> Any leg whose action runs `developTicketAndCreatePR.js` (story, bug, and dynamic-repo variants) reads the knob — the same surface as `customParams.feedbackLoop`.

Non-blocking; documentation-surface clarity only.

- 💡 SUGESTION — README scopes the knob to `story_development` only, but the bug leg already reads it (`js/developBugAndCreatePR.js:870`) and the generated docs list it for three agents.

**Ranked digest** (no threads):
- `js/common/developmentMode.js:44` — `describeRawValue` can `JSON.stringify` an arbitrarily large config object into a single warn line (log-noise only; cannot throw).
